summary: Canonical immutable type handles, checked-HIR inspection, scalar/numeric MIR inspection and evaluation, bounded deterministic serialization, and rollback-capable candidate MIR transactions are executable. Broader inference/layout/effect APIs, aggregate/resource/effect MIR lowering, public host admission/publication, and installed canonical-frontend linkage remain outside this worker's integrated scope.

implemented: canonical On1x Type construction with owner/generation/revision checks
immutable retained handles and borrowed views
kind, child, label, nominal, extent, flags and spelling queries
bounded type-form verification, structural equality and forall-instance checks
unsupported: public unification, inference, constraint solving, layout, borrow and effect services

implemented: private host-only canonical Unit admission to CHECKED_HIR
immutable revision-bound HIR traversal with stale and cross-context rejection
mandatory canonical lowering and verification to scalar/numeric VERIFIED_MIR
structured function, block, instruction, terminator, type and source views
unsupported: foreign declarations without separate host admission evidence
aggregate, resource or effect constructs not representable by canonical scalar/numeric MIR

implemented: bounded bytes, nodes, work, depth, UTF-8, identity and version validation
candidate-only decode and deterministic round trips
